fusions.name: Mouldy Mouthful
fusions.desc: A bite that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds, with a 30% chance to leave it [Diseased] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Spore Cough
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. You cough a cloud of spores through a cone 3.5 tiles long for 9 damage, with a 50% chance to leave each target [Diseased] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Mycelial Den
fusions.desc: Raises a patch of fungus where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Mouldering Companion
fusions.desc: A bonded hound grown over with mould fights beside you, biting enemies within 4 tiles for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds. Each bite leaves the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.
